query: select t.term_code,t.extended_name,t.deprecated,h.hierarchy_code,h.parent_code,h.reportable from terms t join term_hierarchies h using(term_code) where h.parent_code='A07VF' and h.hierarchy_code='targcon' order by t.term_code
